description: Nova42 gives authorized retail teams a read-only conversational view of their latest published workspace data. Track performance, prepare retailer meetings, prioritize current issues, analyze confirmed price evidence, and verify distribution coverage. Every result remains limited to the signed-in user's authorized workspaces, reports publication freshness, and distinguishes observed values, explicit zeroes, null values, absent data, and data not yet observed.

defaultPrompt: Summarize my workspace performance this week: KPIs, important changes, and main risks.
Which issues require attention today, and why?
Which catalogue products are confirmed as not listed at the most relevant retailer for this workspace?
